title: The Rock Sings a Sweet Song for His Daughters
summary:
Guess what? Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson — the big, strong wrestler and movie star — has a new job: singer! He just released a sweet song called 'Your Dad' for his three daughters. And it's not a joke. He actually sings from his heart (and in keys that don't exist, as he says).

The song is on a new album called 'Moana: Voices Across the Ocean.' He co-wrote it with Iam Tongi, who won American Idol in 2023. The music video shows home movies of The Rock playing with his girls: Simone (24), Jasmine (10), and Tiana (8).

In the song, he sings, 'Now you go move those mountains / And sail across the oceans / Go show the world and prove / There's nothing you can't do.' That's like a dad cheering you on!

The Rock told Rolling Stone that singing is in his blood. He grew up in a Polynesian family where everyone sang and danced. He also loves old country music stars like Sam Cooke and Willie Nelson. Willie Nelson even gave him a guitar — one of only 100 copies of his famous 'Trigger' guitar!

At first, Iam Tongi wrote a song about his own dad who passed away. The Rock loved it but wanted it to be about his daughters instead. So they changed it together. The Rock said he cried when he first heard it.

He says this song is special because it's just for him and his girls. There's no pressure about sales or box office. Just a dad singing to his kids. How cool is that?
why_it_matters: It shows that even big, tough dads can express their feelings and cheer on their kids in creative ways, much like a parent cheering you on at a school event or a game.

background_read: Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson first became famous as a professional wrestler and then as a movie star. He voiced the character Maui in the Disney movie Moana, which celebrates Polynesian culture.
Willie Nelson is a legendary country singer and guitarist. His guitar 'Trigger' is so famous that only 100 copies of it were ever made.
Article_Structure: WHO: Dwayne 'The Rock' Johnson, his three daughters (Simone, Jasmine, Tiana), and singer-songwriter Iam Tongi.
WHAT: The Rock released a personal song called 'Your Dad' on the album Moana: Voices Across the Ocean, co-written with Iam Tongi, with a music video showing home movies.
WHERE: The song is part of a Moana-inspired album, and its video uses home footage — not a concert or movie set.
WHY: To give his daughters a heartfelt message of encouragement and love, with no pressure from sales or Hollywood success.

perspectives.description: For his daughters, this song is a priceless gift that they can keep forever, full of pride and support from their famous father.
Many fans only know The Rock as an action hero or wrestler, so seeing him sing a tender song might feel unexpected, but it shows a softer side of him.
The Rock did this just for himself and his family, without caring about charts or reviews — which can be very freeing for any performer.
